+def test_get_conflicted_files_refname_collision(in_merge_conflict):
+    """A tracked file named like a refname must not make git ambiguous"""
+    resolve_conflict()
+
+    with open('HEAD', 'w') as head_file:
+        head_file.write('head')
+    cmd_output('git', 'add', 'HEAD')
+
+    ret = set(git.get_conflicted_files())
+    assert ret == {'HEAD', 'conflict_file'}
+
+
 def test_get_conflicted_files_in_submodule(in_conflicting_submodule):
     resolve_conflict()
     assert set(git.get_conflicted_files()) == {'conflict_file'}
